info.title: Digital Banking - User Service (Phase 3, standalone)
info.description: Standalone user profile and wallet API for development. Uses opaque development sessions (AUTH_MODE=dev) so profile endpoints can be tested without auth-service. This authentication mode is NOT production-ready. See docs/INTEGRATION.md for the JWT integration plan. Phase 3 posts every wallet change through a double-entry ledger; balances are liabilities and are never treated as revenue. All responses use the envelope `{ success, message, data | errors }`. Password hashes are never returned.

post.description: Authenticates a standalone UserProfile with email and password and returns an opaque Bearer token stored (hashed) in DevSession. Development only — not production-ready.

get.description: Returns the safe profile for the user bound to the current development session token. The user id is taken only from the verified session — never from the query string or body. Development Bearer auth is temporary and for local testing only; it is not production JWT integration with auth-service. Sensitive fields (passwordHash, tokens) are never returned.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Ignored. Present only to document that client-supplied user ids cannot select another profile.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or expired development session

patch.description: Updates the authenticated user profile using JSON or multipart/form-data. Multipart requests may include a verified PNG, JPEG, or WebP avatar up to 5 MB; files are stored on the persistent user-service volume. Permitted profile fields are firstName, middleName, lastName, phoneNumber, gender, dateOfBirth, addressLine1, addressLine2, city, state, postalCode, country, bio, and avatarUrl. Protected identity fields are rejected.

clearMiddleName.summary: Clear middle name with empty string

avatar.description: Optional PNG, JPEG, or WebP image up to 5 MB.

200.description: Profile updated (or unchanged permitted fields written successfully)

400.description: Validation failed: empty body, invalid profile fields, protected fields, or an invalid, unsupported, or oversized avatar image.

errors.message: dateOfBirth must be a valid date in the past

409.description: Reserved for future uniqueness conflicts (email/username are not editable here, so not currently returned)

post.summary: Initialize a Chapa Test Mode wallet deposit
post.description: Creates an idempotent ETB hosted checkout. A browser redirect never credits the wallet; the provider status must be verified server-side.

501.description: Chapa Test Mode is not configured

example.message: External payments are unavailable until Chapa Test Mode is configured

get.description: Owner-scoped status check. Calls Chapa's verification API and credits only when provider status, merchant reference, amount, and currency all match.

404.description: Payment not found or not owned by the authenticated user

409.description: Provider reference, amount, or currency mismatch

post.summary: Receive a signed Chapa Test Mode payment webhook
post.description: Signature is lowercase-hex HMAC-SHA256 of the exact raw JSON body using CHAPA_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Every event triggers server-side provider verification; duplicate deliveries are idempotent.

Internal withdrawal lifecycle only. The amount is debited from the wallet and credited to PLATFORM:WITHDRAWAL_RESERVED through a balanced journal entry. No external payout is performed because the configured provider (Chapa) exposes no payout capability; a pending withdrawal can only be cancelled, which reverses the reservation. Withdrawals with a non-zero configured fee are rejected until a payout provider is integrated.

409.description: Insufficient balance, wallet inactive, policy limit, withdrawal fee unsupported, or idempotency conflict

get.summary: Get one of the authenticated user's withdrawals

404.description: Withdrawal not found or not owned by the authenticated user

post.description: Posts a compensating journal entry that debits PLATFORM:WITHDRAWAL_RESERVED and credits the wallet, then marks the withdrawal CANCELLED. Cancelling an already-cancelled withdrawal is idempotent. No external payout is reversed because none was made.

404.description: Withdrawal not found or not owned by the authenticated user

409.description: Withdrawal is not in a cancellable state

post.description: Chapa Test Mode exposes no refund API. This route fails closed with 501 and never changes ledger state; internal transfers are corrected through administrator reversals.

example.message: Chapa refunds are not supported by this service; internal transfer reversals are available to administrators

get.summary: Get a transaction visible to the authenticated user

404.description: Transaction not found or not visible to the authenticated user

post.summary: Reverse a posted transfer (full or partial)
post.description: Administrator-only compensating reversal. The original journal entry is never edited or deleted; a new balanced journal entry is posted that links to the original. Omitting `amount` reverses the remaining reversible amount. The same Idempotency-Key replays the previously posted reversal. Legacy transactions migrated from the pre-ledger schema (status LEGACY) cannot be reversed.

409.description: Legacy transaction, already fully reversed, amount exceeds remaining reversible amount, or concurrent reversal conflict

patch.description: Changes the authenticated user password. The new password must be 8-72 characters and differ from the current password; confirmation must match. Validation responses include field-specific messages.

example.message: Password has been changed. Other development sessions were revoked.

400.description: Validation failed (missing/empty/unexpected fields, newPassword under 8 characters, confirmation mismatch, new password identical to current) or unsafe request

errors.newPassword: newPassword must be at least 8 characters

500.description: Internal server error (details not exposed; no false success)

get.description: Returns the active limits and fee configuration per policy type and currency. All money fields are decimal strings with two fractional digits.

patch.summary: Update a financial policy with an audited reason
patch.description: Every change requires a reason of at least 10 characters and writes a FinancialPolicyRevision snapshot with the acting administrator. Limits apply server-side at request time; the day boundary is evaluated in the policy timezone.

example.reason: Raise the pilot daily transfer count

post.summary: Run payment reconciliation for stale pending deposits
post.description: Re-verifies pending payments older than the stale threshold against the trusted provider and records one attempt per payment. A provider timeout never marks a payment failed; ambiguous outcomes are flagged MANUAL_REVIEW. Repeated or concurrent runs cannot double-credit because completion is idempotent.

devBearer.description: Opaque development session token from POST /api/v1/auth/dev-login. NOT a production JWT.

devApiKey.name: X-Dev-Api-Key
devApiKey.description: Optional. Required only when DEV_API_KEY is configured.

amount.description: Positive amount; at most two fractional digits.

status.description: LEDGER provenance. LEGACY rows predate the ledger migration and cannot be reversed through the ledger.

ledgerEntryReference.description: Journal entry that posted this transaction; null for LEGACY rows.

amount.description: Optional positive amount. Omit to reverse the remaining reversible amount.
Positive ETB amount with at most two fractional digits.

status.description: Internal lifecycle only. There is no COMPLETED state because no payout provider is integrated.

outcome.description: MATCHED means the provider state was applied locally. PENDING means the provider still reports an unresolved state. MISMATCH means amount/currency/reference disagreement; no credit is posted.

total.description: Number of transactions matching the current filters, unaffected by pagination.

amount.description: ETB amount, minimum 1.00. Chapa receives the equivalent integer number of cents.
